luna_art_direction.art_direction_ar: بطاقة نصية محلية لا مولد صور: إغلاق هادئ للنص بعد اكتمال الحركة، مع ظهور كلمة «أجمعون» كما وردت دون زخرفة زائدة.

cinematic_blueprint.action: After the preceding visual movement has completed, reveal the supplied verse text on a pure black field; the white text remains stable, then the final light trace fades precisely as the supplied word «أجمعون» reaches its ending.
cinematic_blueprint.camera: No camera movement; fixed full-frame graphic composition with no simulated depth or zoom.
cinematic_blueprint.color_palette: Pure white typography on absolute black.
cinematic_blueprint.composition: Centered text block with disciplined margins, one typographic focal point, balanced negative space, and no secondary imagery.
cinematic_blueprint.continuity: SEQ-09, SH-043; preserve the established symbolic unseen domain, right-to-left visual logic where applicable, charcoal-to-white transition, and adjacent-shot timing; no location illustration.
cinematic_blueprint.lighting: Not applicable; uniform white text opacity with a controlled fade of the final light trace.
cinematic_blueprint.materials: Clean digital-black field and crisp high-contrast white typography; no texture unless already specified by the approved typography package.
cinematic_blueprint.safety: Text-only symbolic closure. Do not depict Allah, angels, prophets, Iblis, bodies, faces, or any unseen being; do not invent or alter religious wording.
cinematic_blueprint.subject: The approved supplied verse text, with the supplied word «أجمعون» appearing exactly as provided.
cinematic_blueprint.temporal_motion: Hold the completed text composition without a freeze-like filler; animate only the final residual light fading once, synchronized to the end of «أجمعون». No morphing letters, flicker, jitter, unintended kerning changes, or extra text.

subtitle_ar: بطاقة نصية محلية لا مولد صور: إغلاق هادئ للنص بعد اكتمال الحركة، مع ظهور كلمة «أجمعون» كما وردت دون زخرفة زائدة.
